summary: AgendaVisite iteration 2 full-stack testing PASSED. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests green (24 legacy + 11 new for /api/clients/all, admin-only agent field, /api/stats/monthly, /api/export/monthly with company names). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844 against public preview URL): the reported bug is confirmed FIXED — on the giro reorder screen (Catanzaro→Guardavalle, 24 loc), the 'Aggiungi località' input (add-loc-input), add button (add-loc-btn), giro-name-input and save button (giro-save-btn) are permanently visible in a fixed top section above a scrollable list; a new locality was added and the giro was saved successfully. Dashboard shows anagrafica-card + statistiche-card + select-giro-card. Anagrafica search 'gramaca' correctly returns exactly 1 client (Gramaca S.r.l., Cessaniti, Umberto). Client detail opens with edit-client-btn; edit form shows admin agent chips (e-agent-umberto/e-agent-andrea), saving updates the anagrafica (city persisted, consulente reassigned to Andrea, 'Anagrafica aggiornata' toast). New-client form for admin shows both agent chips; save-client-btn creates the client. Statistiche screen renders 7 giro chips (horizontal), 3 year chips (2024/2025/2026), and download-excel-btn. Two non-blocking RN-web console warnings persist ('shadow*' style props deprecated; props.pointerEvents deprecated) — same as iteration 1, still pending. No new bugs found. Deprecated packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports detected.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Same as iteration 1; migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow. Reference: sweep /app/frontend/src/theme and any StyleSheet with shadow* keys.
React Native Web console warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Migrate deprecated RN Web style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking console warnings only.

(Optional) Add a hard DELETE (or soft-delete admin) endpoint for /api/clients/{id}; test suite currently leaves TEST_* clients behind (~15 rows) because there is no cleanup path — they are all prefixed TEST_ for easy manual purge.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_client silently drops the agent field when a non-admin sends it (line 569-571). This is correct behavior, and test_non_admin_cannot_change_agent_on_own verifies it — good.
server.py list_all_clients returns clients for admin regardless of agent (no filter) which is the intended admin scope; verified.
_monthly_grid respects role — admin sees every agent's clients in the giro, agent sees only own — verified against the data (umberto=633 all, andrea=~84 own).

rca_of_issue: The reported bug (Aggiungi località hidden when giri have many localities, e.g. 24) is FIXED. RCA: previously the input + add button sat inside the same scrollable list container so it scrolled off-screen. Fix (verified in /app/frontend/app/giro/[id].tsx lines 101-131): the name field, add-locality row, and section title live in a fixed top block outside DraggableFlatList; only the localities list scrolls. Verified end-to-end on 'Catanzaro -> Guardavalle' (24 loc): the button remained visible before/after scrolling the list to the bottom, adding a new locality worked, save persisted. No further mitigation needed.
